name: school-fee-management-api
description: Backend API for the School Fee Management SaaS

scripts.prisma:init: npx prisma orm init --target postgres --authoring psl --yes
scripts.prisma:migrate: npx prisma db update --dry-run && npx prisma db update
scripts.prisma:reset:full: rm -rf prisma/migrations prisma/contract.json node_modules/.prisma && npx prisma cache clear && npx prisma contract emit && npx prisma db init && npx prisma db verify
scripts.prisma:reset:clean: rm -rf prisma/migrations && npx prisma contract emit && npx prisma db init
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:emit && npm run prisma:sign && npm run prisma:verify
scripts.db:rebuild: npm run prisma:reset:full && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:reset-full: rm -rf prisma/migrations prisma/contract.json node_modules/.prisma && npx prisma cache clear && npx prisma contract emit && npx prisma db init && npx prisma db verify
scripts.db:reset-migrations: rm -rf prisma/migrations && npx prisma contract emit && npx prisma db init
scripts.db:reset-database: npx prisma db reset --force && npx prisma db sign
